title: Center of Mass of a Semicircular Wire
author: Muhammad Abdullah Athar
problemStatement: Find the center of mass of a uniform semicircular wire of radius a = pi in the upper half-plane.

steps.title: Compute Total Mass with Uniform Density delta = 1
steps.explanation: The mass is the arc length of the semicircle.

steps.title: Evaluate First Moment M_x and y_bar
steps.mathExpression: M_x = \int_0^\pi (a\sin t)(a \, dt) = a^2 [-\cos t]_0^\pi = 2a^2; \quad \bar{y} = \frac{M_x}{M} = \frac{2a^2}{\pi a} = \frac{2a}{\pi}
steps.explanation: Integrate y ds = a sin(t) a dt.
steps.why: Evaluating first moment and vertical balance point.

steps.title: Substitute Numerical Radius a = pi
steps.explanation: Substitute a = pi to obtain center of mass (0, 2).
